req.title: Set cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall set cookies for every k=v pair supplied in the query string of GET /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /cookies/set sets cookies for every k=v pair in the query string and redirects to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive - single and multiple cookies are set correctly with exact values; (2) negative - no query params yields no cookies; (3) boundary - empty string value, single char key/value, special characters. Mutation resilience requires exact status code assertions (302 redirect), exact cookie key/value assertions, and verifying both presence and absence of cookies. The follow_redirects=True path lets us verify the final /cookies JSON payload, while follow_redirects=False lets us verify the 302 redirect itself.

tests.name: test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: single k=v pair sets exactly that cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['foo'] == 'bar'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_initial_redirect_is_302
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: endpoint redirects to /cookies after setting cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_initial_redirect_is_302():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?x=y', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/cookies' in location
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303

trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: cookie is actually set in the HTTP response headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_response_contains_set_cookie_header():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?session=abc123', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'session=abc123' in set_cookie
    assert 'session' in set_cookie

def test_set_cookie_exact_count_two_params():
